name: story
wording: One thin slice of behaviour a user can rely on, written by the architect in the design's own terms: the slice and why it is wanted, its acceptance criteria, what is out of scope, which path it takes and how much review that warrants, and roughly what it will cost; examples are added where misunderstanding is likely. It is done when its acceptance criteria hold in merged work.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated.
